tweet.text:
Brookfield is giving up the $600M, 785-unit Beaudry tower in downtown Los Angeles, less than four years after it opened, rather than refinance a loan of about $360M.

The lender, Apollo-owned Bridge Investment Group, is working to sell the loan. 

The tower is about 95% occupied at asking rents near $4,200.

Office vacancy rates remain roughly double what they were in 2019, while apartment rents are just now back to levels seen before the pandemic.

"Rising over 600 feet, it offers innovative design, exceptional amenities, and open homes with unparalleled city, mountain, and ocean vistas for an elevated urban lifestyle."

"The tower features an outdoor pool at level three, multiple amenity decks including a rooftop amenity deck, BBQ area, water features, community rooms, pet spa, game room, gym, ballet studio, and a golf simulator." - Webcor
